info.title: Hexagon API
info.description: Anonymous public reads plus authenticated, idempotent submissions. The Atom query endpoint mirrors the relevant arXiv API surface; Hexagon-specific evidence and source links are additive extensions. Submission routes accept either an ORCID-authenticated browser session or an account-issued, narrowly scoped bearer credential.

get.summary: Query records using the arXiv-compatible Atom interface

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: Fielded search, at most 4096 characters: all, ti, au, abs, cat, and id; AND, OR, and ANDNOT are supported. Individual search terms must fit D1's 50-byte UTF-8 LIKE-pattern limit.

parameters.name: id_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated Hexagon identifiers, at most 2048 characters and 50 identifiers.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based result offset.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Number of results, at most 2000; start plus max_results may not exceed 30000.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: relevance, lastUpdatedDate, or submittedDate.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: ascending or descending.

post.summary: Query records using the read-only arXiv-compatible Atom interface
post.description: Equivalent to GET, with parameters encoded as application/x-www-form-urlencoded. This operation does not modify repository state.

get.summary: Get a work and its public file inventory
get.description: Returns scholarly metadata and a public file projection. Internal screening, processing, and operational provenance are retained by Hexagon but are not exposed here.

200.description: Hexagon work with public files, tool, and MSC metadata

get.summary: List or read a public source tree
get.description: Anonymous public read. Without path, returns the versioned source-tree manifest, including the entry point, every public file's relative path, role, media type, size, SHA-256 digest, and bounded content/download links. With path, returns that public textual source file as UTF-8 text. Binary or withheld files are never coerced into text.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Exact relative path from the returned source-tree manifest

200.description: JSON source-tree manifest, or text/plain UTF-8 file content when path is supplied

404.description: Public source tree or file not found

413.description: Text file exceeds the 4 MiB public response limit

415.description: Requested path is a binary source file

503.description: Stored source bytes are temporarily unavailable or failed integrity checks

put.summary: Set or clear the submitter-declared arXiv identifier of a record
put.description: Requires the submitting contributor's authenticated browser session; a moderator may only clear it (arxivId null). The identifier is a record-level annotation shown on every version; changing it never creates a new version, and every change is audited. Hexagon does not verify it.

200.description: Normalized arXiv identifier stored, or cleared when null

403.description: Untrusted request origin, unverified contact email, or a moderator attempting to set a value

404.description: Record not found for this submitter or moderator

409.description: The record can no longer be changed, or it changed concurrently

put.description: Requires the submitting contributor's authenticated browser session. A moderator may remove existing links but may not add or change them. Links apply to every version, changes never create a new version, and every change is audited.

403.description: Untrusted request origin or a moderator attempting to add or change a link

404.description: Record not found for this submitter or moderator

409.description: The record can no longer be changed, or it changed concurrently

get.summary: List the complete cross-list taxonomy and primary-subject eligibility
get.description: Every exposed category may be used as a cross-list. The primaryEligible field identifies the narrower math-and-adjacent-v1 public-beta intake policy.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Optional exact subject-group name

200.description: Taxonomy version, primary-subject policy version, and subjects

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Code prefix or words from an MSC2020 label

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Set to assignable to return only five-character deposit classifications

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 50

200.description: Catalogue metadata and matching MSC2020 entries

get.summary: List depositor-supplied tags used by public records
BibTeX entry for a published work version

200.description: BibTeX entry for a published work version

post.summary: Create or resume a deposit draft
post.description: Requires an authenticated browser session or a submissions:write bearer credential and an Idempotency-Key header. The same key and metadata return the same 24-hour draft within that principal. A credential is fixed to either the owner's personal identity or one exact administrator-approved submit-as identity.

get.summary: Read draft, upload, and processing status

200.description: Private draft status, including the pending record-level arxivId beside metadataJson

patch.summary: Replace the metadata for an editable deposit draft

409.description: Draft is not editable, or arxivId was omitted and the pending value changed concurrently (reload and retry)

post.summary: Create or resume a new draft after moderator-requested changes

409.description: The submission is not awaiting changes

post.summary: Create or resume one multipart file upload

200.description: Existing matching upload (same file name, type, and size): resume it

409.description: A different file is already staged at that path; the body carries existingUploadId so the caller can remove it first

patch.summary: Classify a supporting source file before commit
patch.description: The draft owner may switch an ordinary supporting file between compilation-input and retained-unused. Main files and anc/ files have fixed roles, and no role can change after commit.

409.description: Role is fixed or the draft is no longer editable

delete.summary: Remove a staged file from a draft that is still uploading
delete.description: Aborts or deletes the private staged object and forgets the upload so the path can be staged again. Only the draft owner's browser session may call it, and only before commit; committed and finalized files are never removed by this operation.

409.description: The draft is no longer uploading

post.summary: Complete a file after verifying contiguous parts and total bytes
Expand a completed source ZIP in a bounded disposable Sandbox
post.description: The preserved archive and every normalized member are bound by hashes. Expansion rejects traversal, links and special entries, encryption, nested archives, unsupported compression, collisions, and fixed count/size/depth/ratio/time limits before any member rows are committed.

201.description: Archive expanded; response lists the normalized tree and eligible .tex main-file candidates

409.description: Draft state or aggregate limits prevent expansion

422.description: Archive rejected by the bounded ingest policy

post.summary: Select exactly one expanded .tex main file
post.description: Selection is limited to a normalized member of this source archive outside the anc/ subtree and remains editable only before commit.

get.summary: Read the draft's compile preview status (owner only)
get.description: Returns the current source-tree digest (entry point, compiler inputs with hashes and roles, requested engine), the latest preview, the soft commit-gate state, and the per-user UTC-day preview allowance. Previews are private and never part of a record.

409.description: The draft is no longer open

post.summary: Queue a compile preview of the staged files (owner only)
post.description: Runs the deterministic source checks, then the same isolated compile core as the record compile; the sanitized PDF carries no Hexagon identifier. One preview per draft may run at a time and each account has a UTC-day cap. Previews never consume submission admissions, and LuaLaTeX sources are not previewed while they are compiled only after moderator review.

200.description: The current files already have a final preview result

409.description: Not ready, already running, engine not previewed, or draft closed

503.description: Previews are paused or could not be queued

get.summary: Static pre-check of the staged TeX sources (owner only, advisory)

200.description: Warnings about references to files or packages that were not found

get.summary: Compiler log of a draft preview (owner only)
Sanitized preview PDF without a Hexagon identifier (owner only)

post.summary: Reserve the permanent identifier and queue source screening
post.description: The reserved identifier remains private until publication and is never reused.

post.summary: Cancel an unpublished submission or withdraw a published paper
post.description: Cancellation accepts either submission authentication mode and keeps an allocated identifier private and unreused. Withdrawal preserves a public citable record, requires a reason, and requires the submitting account's browser session.

409.description: Action does not apply to the current state

post.summary: Call the read-only Hexagon MCP server using Streamable HTTP
post.description: Implements MCP protocol 2025-06-18. Only read-only scholarship, source, subject, tool, and MSC metadata tools are exposed.

get.summary: ZIP archive of the source files available to the requester

200.description: ZIP archive of the source files available to the requester

browserSession.name: __Host-mathlake_session
browserSession.description: Hexagon browser session established through ORCID OAuth. Browser sessions are not credentials for external automation.

submissionBearer.description: Account-issued submissions:write credential. It may access only drafts it created, is fixed to one personal or administrator-approved submit-as identity, expires within 365 days, uses the account's ordinary submission allowance, and never grants moderation, discussion, account, or general write access.

subject.description: Primary subject permitted by public-beta policy math-and-adjacent-v1.

crossListSubjects.description: Up to eight distinct non-primary categories permitted by public-beta policy math-and-adjacent-v1.

mscCodes.description: Required five-character classifications from the complete MSC2020 catalogue.

authorshipMode.description: Compatibility property used only for the text-origin declaration: primarily AI-generated, mixed, or primarily human-written. It is not a claim that an AI system is an author.

submittingContributorIndex.description: Zero-based position of the contributor server-bound to the authenticated submitter.

aiSystems.description: Computational tools used. The internal compatibility property name is retained while public read projections call these tools.

formalizations.description: Optional repeatable links to allowlisted formalization hosts.

sponsorName.description: Submitter display name. The server replaces this with the authenticated account name; the property name is retained for API compatibility.

submittingOrganizationId.description: For administrator-approved third-party submission, the exact submit-as permission id. A bearer credential fixes this value for its lifetime; use null for the owner's personal ORCID identity.

humanUnderstanding.description: Whether all, some, or none of the contribution has been checked and understood by a human at submission time.

provenance.description: Optional provenance statement; required when humanUnderstanding is some.

mathlibCommitUrl.description: Legacy single Mathlib link. New clients should use formalizations.

palomarUrl.description: Optional public, version-specific Palomar registry record URL. Private status links are not accepted.

prove2Url.description: Optional public formalization link on https://prove2.me.

arxivId.description: Optional arXiv identifier of the same work (YYMM.NNNN[N][vN] or archive/YYMMNNN[vN]; arXiv: prefixes and arxiv.org abs/pdf URLs are normalized). Submitter-declared and not verified by Hexagon. Applies to the whole record: it is stored beside (not inside) draft metadataJson and returned as arxivId by GET /api/v1/submissions/{draftId}; omitting it from a draft update keeps the pending value and null clears it. It seeds the record at the first commit, is ignored by revisions, and is changed later through PUT /api/v1/works/{identifier}/arxiv-id.

rightsConfirmed.description: May be false while privately processing a draft; must be true for final submission.

kind.description: The main source file must end in .tex. Supporting source assets may include PDF figures, which are validated inside the isolated compiler before use and withheld from public download as raw bytes. Structured text under anc/ may preserve submitter-supplied AI provenance, is screened before publication, and is never compiled or executed. Source archives are ZIP-only, expanded through the bounded ingest route, preserved as archive evidence, and never executed. Formal artifacts are preserved in restricted storage, excluded from compilation, never executed, and withheld from public download.

sizeBytes.description: Main source files and textual source assets, including ancillary provenance files, are additionally limited to 4 MiB each.

SourceTreeManifest.description: Normalized immutable source-tree foundation. Held or unpublished manifests remain subject to the same authorization boundary as their record.

entryPoint.description: Exactly one safe relative .tex path selected as the main file.

archive.description: Preserved original ZIP identity and bounded extraction-policy provenance.
